metadata.description: GENUINE: live-captured with tools/mock-capture against UEM 26.2 (as8006) on 2026-09-24, in a disposable sdktestrun org group created for this capture under the shared parent (every created object deleted afterwards with a second-DELETE proof; the shared parent's snapshot was unchanged).
